rule: Each entry records one private mirror adopting the status already carried by its merged tracked authority. Adoption copies a merged value; it never produces proof and never advances a status no merged record holds.
integrity_rule: Every digest in this ledger must resolve against a file that exists. tools/check-program.mjs re-verifies them, so a stale attestation fails closed rather than quietly asserting something unverifiable.

other_recorded_mutations.what_changed: captured_at 2026-07-22 -> 2026-07-25, a new captured_at_commit, a new snapshot_role string, a recomputed aggregate_sha256, and recomputed per-owner digests.
other_recorded_mutations.what_did_not_change: No status, objective, scope, proof, claim, or nonclaim field was touched.
other_recorded_mutations.why: The snapshots pinned canon digests from the divergent branch a894b25054, which is not an ancestor of master. Left as they were, every record would have reported stale against merged canon. The re-capture is provenance maintenance, not a status or scope change.
other_recorded_mutations.disclosure_note: Recorded here after an independent review correctly observed that a mass provenance mutation had been performed with no manifest entry. A silent bulk rewrite of provenance is exactly the pattern this estate exists to prevent.
